frontmatter.title: Specification over implementation notes
frontmatter.description: Platform-spec text supersedes informal crate comments for HIR normalization and legality.

body:
import SpecAdrChrome from '@beskid/docs-ui/platform-spec/SpecAdrChrome.astro';

<SpecAdrChrome />

## Context

Implementation crates accumulated informal notes that diverged from published contracts.

## Decision

Normative platform-spec prose and ADRs under this feature **supersede** informal comments in implementation crates until explicitly migrated into spec text.

## Consequences

Engineers file spec/ADR updates when behavior changes; crate comments are non-authoritative for conformance arguments.

## Verification anchors

- `compiler/crates/beskid_analysis/src/resolve/mod.rs`
- `compiler/crates/beskid_analysis/src/resolve/resolver.rs`
- `compiler/crates/beskid_analysis/src/analysis/rules/staged/definitions.rs`
